==== artifacts/project-ice/public/world.js ====
--- 1-228 ---
1: /* ============================================================
2:    PROJECT ICE — world.js
3:    Build 0.0.1
4: 
5:    World Engine — foundational data layer.
6:    Holds all game-world state separately from the player save.
7:    Player saves reference the world via worldRef: 'default'.
8: 
9:    Future systems (simulation, scheduling, roster generation)
10:    read and write through this object. This file has zero
11:    knowledge of game.js or the DOM; it is pure data + logic.
12:    ============================================================ */
13: 
14: 'use strict';
15: 
16: /* global WorldEngine */
17: 
18: const WorldEngine = (() => {
19: 
20:   // ── Storage key (separate from the player SAVE_KEY) ────────
21:   const WORLD_KEY = 'projectice_world';
22: 
23:   /*
24:    * ============================================================
25:    * WORLD STORAGE — INDEXEDDB
26:    * ============================================================
27:    *
28:    * The Project Ice world has outgrown localStorage.
29:    *
30:    * localStorage remains available temporarily as a migration
31:    * source for older saves, but the full world state will now live
32:    * in IndexedDB so large rosters, schedules, stats and history can
33:    * persist safely.
34:    */
35: 
36:   const WORLD_DB_NAME =
37:     'projectice_database';
38: 
39:   const WORLD_DB_VERSION =
40:     1;
41: 
42:   const WORLD_STORE_NAME =
43:     'worlds';
44: 
45:   const WORLD_RECORD_ID =
46:     'default';
47: 
48:   function openWorldDatabase() {
49:     return new Promise(
50:       (resolve, reject) => {
51:         const request =
52:           indexedDB.open(
53:             WORLD_DB_NAME,
54:             WORLD_DB_VERSION
55:           );
56: 
57:         request.onupgradeneeded =
58:           event => {
59:             const database =
60:               event.target.result;
61: 
62:             if (
63:               !database.objectStoreNames
64:                 .contains(
65:                   WORLD_STORE_NAME
66:                 )
67:             ) {
68:               database.createObjectStore(
69:                 WORLD_STORE_NAME,
70:                 {
71:                   keyPath: 'id',
72:                 }
73:               );
74:             }
75:           };
76: 
77:         request.onsuccess =
78:           () => {
79:             resolve(
80:               request.result
81:             );
82:           };
83: 
84:         request.onerror =
85:           () => {
86:             reject(
87:               request.error ||
88:               new Error(
89:                 'Could not open Project Ice IndexedDB.'
90:               )
91:             );
92:           };
93:       }
94:     );
95:   }

4066:   function saveWeeklyLivingWorldSnapshot(
4067:     snapshot
4068:   ) {
4069:     if (
4070:       !snapshot ||
4071:       typeof snapshot !== 'object'
4072:     ) {
4073:       return false;
4074:     }
4075: 
4076:     if (
4077:       !_state.season ||
4078:       typeof _state.season !== 'object'
4079:     ) {
4080:       ensureCanonicalSeasonState(
4081:         _state
4082:       );
4083:     }
4084: 
4085:     if (
4086:       !Array.isArray(
4087:         _state.season.weeklyHistory
4088:       )
4089:     ) {
4090:       _state.season.weeklyHistory = [];
4091:     }
4092: 
4093:     const safeWeek =
4094:       Math.max(
4095:         1,
4096:         Number(snapshot.week) || 1
4097:       );
4098: 
4099:     const existingIndex =
4100:       _state.season.weeklyHistory
4101:         .findIndex(
4102:           record =>
4103:             Number(record?.week) ===
4104:             safeWeek
4105:         );
4106: 
4107:     const frozenSnapshot =
4108:       structuredClone(snapshot);
4109: 
4110:     if (existingIndex >= 0) {
4111:       _state.season.weeklyHistory[
4112:         existingIndex
4113:       ] = frozenSnapshot;
4114:     } else {
4115:       _state.season.weeklyHistory.push(
4116:         frozenSnapshot
4117:       );
4118:     }
4119: 
4120:     _state.season.weeklyHistory.sort(
4121:       (firstRecord, secondRecord) =>
4122:         Number(firstRecord?.week) -
4123:         Number(secondRecord?.week)
4124:     );
4125: 
4126:     if (
4127:       _state.season.weeklyHistory
4128:         .length > 64
4129:     ) {
4130:       _state.season.weeklyHistory =
4131:         _state.season.weeklyHistory
4132:           .slice(-64);
4133:     }
4134: 
4135:     return true;
4136:   }

37366:   const HIGH_SCHOOL_RIVALRIES = [
37367:     [
37368:       'team-summit-academy',
37369:       'team-oakridge',
37370:     ],
37371:     [
37372:       'team-iron-peak',

37385:   function isHighSchoolRivalry(
37386:     firstTeamId,
37387:     secondTeamId
37388:   ) {
37389:     return HIGH_SCHOOL_RIVALRIES.some(
37390:       ([rivalA, rivalB]) =>
37391:         (
37392:           rivalA === firstTeamId &&
37393:           rivalB === secondTeamId
37394:         ) ||
37395:         (
37396:           rivalA === secondTeamId &&
37397:           rivalB === firstTeamId
37398:         )
37399:     );
37400:   }
37401:   function getHighSchoolScoutAttendance({
37402:     homeTeam,
37403:     awayTeam,
37404:     cycle,
37405:     round,
37406:     matchupIndex,
37407:   }) {
37408:     const homePrestige =
37409:       Number(homeTeam?.prestige) || 1;
37410: 
37411:     const awayPrestige =
37412:       Number(awayTeam?.prestige) || 1;
37413: 
37414:     const combinedPrestige =
37415:       homePrestige + awayPrestige;
37416: 
37417:     /*
37418:      * Deterministic seed:
37419:      * The same schedule structure always produces the same
37420:      * scout-attendance pattern instead of changing randomly
37421:      * whenever the game reloads.
37422:      */
37423:     const scheduleSeed =
37424:       (
37425:         (cycle + 1) * 17 +
37426:         (round + 1) * 11 +
37427:         (matchupIndex + 1) * 7 +
37428:         combinedPrestige * 5
37429:       ) % 100;
37430: 
37431:     let scoutChance = 12;
37432: 
37433:     // Stronger programs naturally attract more attention.
37434:     if (combinedPrestige >= 9) {
37435:       scoutChance += 20;
37436:     } else if (combinedPrestige >= 7) {
37437:       scoutChance += 12;
37438:     } else if (combinedPrestige >= 5) {
37439:       scoutChance += 5;
37440:     }
37441: 
37442:     // Attention rises as the season progresses.
37443:     if (cycle === 1) {
37444:       scoutChance += 5;
37445:     } else if (cycle === 2) {
37446:       scoutChance += 10;
37447:     } else if (cycle === 3) {
37448:       scoutChance += 16;
37449:     }
37450: 
37451:     if (scheduleSeed >= scoutChance) {
37452:       return 0;
37453:     }
37454: 
37455:     // Bigger matchups can attract multiple scouts.
37456:     if (
37457:       combinedPrestige >= 9 &&
37458:       scheduleSeed < 12
37459:     ) {
37460:       return 3;
37461:     }
37462: 
37463:     if (
37464:       combinedPrestige >= 7 &&
37465:       scheduleSeed < 20
37466:     ) {
37467:       return 2;
37468:     }
37469: 
37470:     return 1;
37471:   }

37862:   // ── Persistence ─────────────────────────────────────────────
37863:   // World state is persisted separately from the player save.
37864:   // Call save() after any simulation step that mutates _state.
37865:   // Call load() in init(); if no stored world exists it silently
37866:   // falls back to defaults.
37867: 
37868:   async function save() {
37869:     const worldSnapshot =
37870:       structuredClone(_state);
37871: 
37872:     /*
37873:      * Primary save: IndexedDB.
37874:      */
37875:     try {
37876:       const database =
37877:         await openWorldDatabase();
37878: 
37879:       await new Promise(
37880:         (resolve, reject) => {
37881:           const transaction =
37882:             database.transaction(
37883:               WORLD_STORE_NAME,
37884:               'readwrite'
37885:             );
37886: 
37887:           const store =
37888:             transaction.objectStore(
37889:               WORLD_STORE_NAME
37890:             );
37891: 
37892:           store.put({
37893:             id:
37894:               WORLD_RECORD_ID,
37895: 
37896:             savedAt:
37897:               new Date()
37898:                 .toISOString(),
37899: 
37900:             world:
37901:               worldSnapshot,
37902:           });
37903: 
37904:           transaction.oncomplete =
37905:             () => {
37906:               resolve();
37907:             };
37908: 
37909:           transaction.onerror =
37910:             () => {
37911:               reject(
37912:                 transaction.error ||
37913:                 new Error(
37914:                   'Project Ice world save transaction failed.'
37915:                 )
37916:               );
37917:             };
37918: 
37919:           transaction.onabort =
37920:             () => {
37921:               reject(
37922:                 transaction.error ||
37923:                 new Error(
37924:                   'Project Ice world save transaction was aborted.'
37925:                 )
37926:               );
37927:             };
37928:         }
37929:       );
37930: 
37931:       database.close();
37932:     } catch (error) {
37933:       console.error(
37934:         '[WorldEngine] IndexedDB save failed:',
37935:         error
37936:       );
37937: 
37938:       return false;
37939:     }
37940: 
37941: 
37942:     return true;
37943:   }
37944: 
37945:   /**
37946:    * Load a persisted world. Merges stored data over defaults so
37947:    * missing fields from older save versions are back-filled.
37948:    * @returns {boolean} true if a stored world was found and loaded.
37949:    */
37950:   async function load() {
37951:     /*
37952:      * ============================================================
37953:      * PRIMARY LOAD — INDEXEDDB
37954:      * ============================================================
37955:      */
37956:     try {
37957:       const database =
37958:         await openWorldDatabase();
37959: 
37960:       const storedRecord =
37961:         await new Promise(
37962:           (resolve, reject) => {
37963:             const transaction =
37964:               database.transaction(
37965:                 WORLD_STORE_NAME,
37966:                 'readonly'
37967:               );
37968: 
37969:             const store =
37970:               transaction.objectStore(
37971:                 WORLD_STORE_NAME
37972:               );
37973: 
37974:             const request =
37975:               store.get(
37976:                 WORLD_RECORD_ID
37977:               );

1265: function isArchetypeValidForPosition(archetype, position) {
1266:   const group = getPositionGroup(position);
1267:   if (!group) return false;
1268:   return (VALID_ARCHETYPES[group] || []).includes(archetype);

2402: // ── Ripple effect ───────────────────────────────────────────
2403: function spawnRipple(button, event) {
2404:   if (!button || button.disabled) return;
2405: 
2406:   const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect();
2407:   const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
2408:   const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
2409:   const size = Math.max(rect.width, rect.height);
2410: 
2411:   const ripple = document.createElement('span');
2412:   ripple.className = 'ripple';
2413: 
2414:   ripple.style.cssText = `
2415:     width: ${size}px;
2416:     height: ${size}px;
2417:     left: ${x - size / 2}px;
2418:     top: ${y - size / 2}px;
2419:   `;
2420: 
2421:   button.appendChild(ripple);
2422: 
2423:   ripple.addEventListener('animationend', () => {
2424:     ripple.remove();
2425:   });
2426: }

2613: function syncCareerPlayerWithWorld() {
2614:   const playerTeamId =
2615:     Game.player.teamId ||
2616:     Game.player.highSchoolTeamId ||
2617:     null;
2618: 
2619:   if (!playerTeamId) {
2620:     return null;
2621:   }
2622: 
2623:   const careerPlayerId =
2624:     Game.player.playerId ||
2625:     Game.player.id ||
2626:     'career-player';
2627: 
2628:   const existingPlayer =
2629:     WorldEngine.getPlayerById(
2630:       careerPlayerId
2631:     );
2632: 
2633:   /*
2634:    * The canonical player already exists.
2635:    * Synchronize Game.player from that record without
2636:    * regenerating attributes or changing lineup placement.
2637:    */
2638:   if (existingPlayer) {
2639:     Game.player = {
2640:       ...Game.player,
2641:       ...existingPlayer,
2642: 
2643:       attributes: {
2644:         ...(existingPlayer.attributes || {}),
2645:       },
2646: 
2647:       seasonStats: {
2648:         ...(existingPlayer.seasonStats || {}),
2649:       },
2650: 
2651:       careerStats: {
2652:         ...(existingPlayer.careerStats || {}),
2653:       },
2654: 
2655:       development: {
2656:         ...(existingPlayer.development || {}),
--- 2950-3363 ---
2950:         const existingEvent =
2951:           findExistingEvent(
2952:             newEvent
2953:           );
2954: 
2955:         if (!existingEvent) {
2956:           return newEvent;
2957:         }
2958: 
2959:         /*
2960:          * Keep the regenerated event definition, but preserve
2961:          * all saved progress/results from the old record.
2962:          */
2963:         return {
2964:           ...newEvent,
2965:           ...existingEvent,
2966: 
2967:           /*
2968:            * Preserve canonical identity fields from the new
2969:            * schedule when the old save did not contain them.
2970:            */
2971:           eventId:
2972:             existingEvent.eventId ||
2973:             newEvent.eventId,
2974: 
2975:           gameId:
2976:             existingEvent.gameId ||
2977:             newEvent.gameId,
2978: 
2979:           id:
2980:             existingEvent.id ||
2981:             newEvent.id,
2982:         };
2983:       }
2984:     );
2985: 
2986:   WorldEngine.save();
2987: 
2988:   console.log(
2989:     '[Career Load] Expanded schedule migrated successfully.'
2990:   );
2991: 
2992:   return true;
2993: }

2995:     function loadCareerPreview() {
2996:       try {
2997:         const savedCareer =
2998:           localStorage.getItem(
2999:             SAVE_KEY
3000:           );
3001: 
3002:         if (savedCareer) {
3003:           const parsedCareer =
3004:             JSON.parse(
3005:               savedCareer
3006:             );
3007: 
3008:           if (
3009:             parsedCareer?.player
3010:           ) {
3011:             Game.player = {
3012:               ...Game.player,
3013:               ...parsedCareer.player,
3014:             };
3015:           }
3016:         } else {
3017:           /*
3018:            * No localStorage preview exists.
3019:            *
3020:            * Recover directly from the canonical IndexedDB world.
3021:            */
3022:           const recovered =
3023:             recoverCareerPreviewFromWorld();
3024: 
3025:           if (!recovered) {
3026:             console.error(
3027:               '[Project Ice] No recoverable career exists in the loaded world.'
3028:             );
3029: 
3030:             return;
3031:           }
3032:         }
3033:     Game.player.currentDate =
3034:       WorldEngine.state.player?.currentDate ||
3035:       Game.player.currentDate ||
3036:       '2026-09-01';
3037: 
3038:     syncCareerPlayerWithWorld();
3039: 
3040:     /*
3041:      * Make normal Continue Career use the same complete
3042:      * season architecture as a newly initialized career.
3043:      */
3044:     ensureCareerScheduleEventsOnLoad();
3045: 
3046:     refreshScheduleEvents();
3047: 
3048:     // ── Route based on career stage ───────────────────────────
3049:     // 'hub' stage → tryouts are done; skip the intro sequence.
3050:     if (Game.player.stage === 'hub') {
3051:         refreshCareerUI();
3052:         showScreen('hub');
3053: 
3054:         ensureHubLiveGameDiagnosticButton();
3055: 
3056:         return;
3057:     }
3058: 
3059:     // Still in creation flow — restore form state and resume at summary.
3060:     firstNameInput.value = Game.player.firstName || '';
3061:     lastNameInput.value = Game.player.lastName || '';
3062:     hometownInput.value = Game.player.hometown || '';
3063: 
3064:     restoreSelectedChoice('position', Game.player.position);
3065:     restoreSelectedChoice('handedness', Game.player.handedness);
3066: 
3067:     updateSummary();
3068:     showScreen('summary');
3069:   } catch (error) {
3070:     console.error('[Project Ice] Load failed:', error);
3071:   }
3072: }

3100: /*
3101:  * ============================================================
3102:  * CAREER EXISTENCE — CANONICAL WORLD CHECK
3103:  * ============================================================
3104:  *
3105:  * IndexedDB / WorldEngine is now the source of truth.
3106:  *
3107:  * The old projectice_save localStorage record is only a
3108:  * compatibility/preview cache and must never be required in
3109:  * order to continue an existing career.
3110:  */
3111: function hasCanonicalCareerWorld() {
3112:   const directCareerPlayer =
3113:     WorldEngine.getPlayerById(
3114:       'career-player'
3115:     );
3116: 
3117:   if (directCareerPlayer) {
3118:     return true;
3119:   }
3120: 
3121:   for (
3122:     const team of
3123:     WorldEngine.state.teams || []
3124:   ) {
3125:     const found =
3126:       (
3127:         team.roster || []
3128:       ).some(
3129:         player =>
3130:           player?.isCareerPlayer ===
3131:             true ||
3132:           String(
3133:             player?.id ||
3134:             player?.playerId ||
3135:             ''
3136:           ) ===
3137:             'career-player'
3138:       );
3139: 
3140:     if (found) {
3141:       return true;
3142:     }
3143:   }
3144: 
3145:   return false;
3146: }

3688:   text.innerHTML = '<span class="cin-title">Freshman Tryouts</span><span class="cin-venue">Ice Den Arena</span>';
3689:   text.style.opacity = '1';

3704: async function runArenaDialogue() {
3705:   await sleep(3000); // brief moment to take in the scene
3706:

3738:   await sleep(2600);
3739: 
3740:   // Line 2 — Player
3741:   await showLine(Game.player.firstName || 'You', 'arena-dialogue__speaker--player',
3742:     '"Yes, sir."');
3743:   await sleep(2000);

22130: function recoverCareerPreviewFromWorld() {
22131:   /*
22132:    * If the small player preview still exists, nothing to recover.
22133:    */
22134:   if (
22135:     localStorage.getItem(
22136:       SAVE_KEY
22137:     )
22138:   ) {
22139:     return true;
22140:   }
22141: 
22142:   /*
22143:    * The canonical World Engine roster is the source of truth.
22144:    * Find the career player that survived in IndexedDB.
22145:    */
22146:   let careerPlayer =
22147:     WorldEngine.getPlayerById(
22148:       'career-player'
22149:     ) ||
22150:     null;
22151: 
22152:   if (!careerPlayer) {
22153:     for (
22154:       const team of
22155:       WorldEngine.state.teams ||
22156:       []
22157:     ) {
22158:       const found =
22159:         (
22160:           team.roster ||
22161:           []
22162:         ).find(
22163:           player =>
22164:             player?.isCareerPlayer ===
22165:             true
22166:         );
22167: 
22168:       if (found) {
22169:         careerPlayer = {
22170:           ...found,
22171:           teamId:
22172:             found.teamId ||
22173:             team.teamId,
22174:           schoolName:
22175:             found.schoolName ||
22176:             team.schoolName,
22177:           teamName:
22178:             found.teamName ||
22179:             team.teamName,
22180:         };
22181: 
22182:         break;
22183:       }
22184:     }
22185:   }
22186: 
22187:   if (!careerPlayer) {
22188:     const rosterCareerPlayers = [];
22189: 
22190:     for (
22191:       const team of
22192:       WorldEngine.state.teams ||
22193:       []
22194:     ) {
22195:       for (
22196:         const player of
22197:         team.roster ||
22198:         []
22199:       ) {
22200:         if (
22201:           player?.isCareerPlayer === true ||
22202:           String(
22203:             player?.id ||
22204:             player?.playerId ||
22205:             ''
22206:           ) === 'career-player'
22207:         ) {
22208:           rosterCareerPlayers.push({
22209:             id:
22210:               player?.id ||
22211:               player?.playerId ||
22212:               'missing',
22213: 
22214:             name:
22215:               `${player?.firstName || ''} ${player?.lastName || ''}`.trim(),
22216: 
22217:             teamId:
22218:               team.teamId,
22219:           });
22220:         }
22221:       }
22222:     }
22223: 
22224:     alert(
22225:       [
22226:         'CAREER RECOVERY DIAGNOSTIC',
22227:         '',
22228:         `World player id: ${
22229:           WorldEngine.state
22230:             ?.player
22231:             ?.id ||
22232:           'missing'
22233:         }`,
22234:         `World player playerId: ${
22235:           WorldEngine.state
22236:             ?.player
22237:             ?.playerId ||
22238:           'missing'
22239:         }`,
22240:         '',
22241:         `Teams: ${
22242:           (
22243:             WorldEngine.state.teams ||
22244:             []
22245:           ).length
22246:         }`,
22247:         `Career players found in rosters: ${
22248:           rosterCareerPlayers.length
22249:         }`,
22250:         '',
22251:         rosterCareerPlayers.length
22252:           ? JSON.stringify(
22253:               rosterCareerPlayers,
22254:               null,
22255:               2
22256:             )
22257:           : 'No canonical career player found.',
22258:       ].join('\n')
22259:     );
22260: 
22261:     return false;
22262:   }
22263: 
22264:   /*
22265:    * Reconstruct Game.player from the canonical player.
22266:    * upsertCareerPlayer originally received the full Game.player,
22267:    * so these identity/career fields should already be preserved.
22268:    */
22269:   Game.player = {
22270:     ...Game.player,
22271:     ...careerPlayer,
22272: 
22273:     playerId:
22274:       careerPlayer.playerId ||
22275:       careerPlayer.id ||
22276:       'career-player',
22277: 
22278:     id:
22279:       careerPlayer.id ||
22280:       careerPlayer.playerId ||
22281:       'career-player',
22282: 
22283:     teamId:
22284:       careerPlayer.teamId ||
22285:       null,
22286: 
22287:     stage:
22288:       'hub',
22289: 
22290:     tryoutsComplete:
22291:       true,
22292: 
22293:     currentDate:
22294:       WorldEngine.state
22295:         .season
22296:         ?.currentDate ||
22297:       careerPlayer.currentDate ||
22298:       Game.player.currentDate,
22299:   };
22300: 
22301:   /*
22302:    * Recreate only the small Continue Career record.
22303:    * The actual universe remains in IndexedDB.
22304:    */
22305:   /*
22306:    * Try to rebuild the lightweight preview cache, but the
22307:    * canonical world no longer depends on that write succeeding.
22308:    */
22309:   saveCareerPreview();
22310: 
22311:   return true;
22312: }
22313: 
22314: // ── App initialization ──────────────────────────────────────
22315: async function init() {
22316:   await WorldEngine.load();
22317: 
22318:   WorldEngine.ensureGeneratedRosters();
22319: 
22320:   /*
22321:    * Careers created before the IndexedDB migration may have lost
22322:    * their small localStorage preview when the old giant world hit
22323:    * the storage quota. Recover it from the canonical world.
22324:    */
22325:   recoverCareerPreviewFromWorld();
22326: 
22327:   updateContinueButton();
22328:   updateDevShortcut();
22329: 
22330:   showScreen('title');
22331: }
